gloss: bending and stretching; flexion and extension

definitions.gloss: bending and stretching; flexion and extension
definitions.explanation: the action of repeatedly bending and straightening a joint or the body, typically as exercise or warm-up

examples.japanese: {屈伸|くっしん}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{屈伸|くっしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}して→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}した→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧。
examples.english: I warmed up by repeatedly bending and stretching my knees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{屈伸|くっしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ほぐしましょう→ほぐす：10496_hogusu⟧。
examples.english: Let's loosen up with some bending and stretching before exercising.

notes:
Refers specifically to the motion of bending and extending joints, most commonly the knees. A standard part of warm-up routines in Japanese physical education and sports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屈伸|くっしん}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: bending and stretching exercise
- ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{屈伸|くっしん}: knee bends
- {屈伸|くっしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bend and stretch
- {屈伸|くっしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧: to repeat bending and stretching

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of {屈|くつ} (to bend) and {伸|しん} (to extend), describing the two opposite movements as a pair.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{準備運動|じゅんびうんどう}→準備運動：14909_junbiundou⟧: warm-up exercise
- ⟦{柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}→柔軟体操：25010_juunantaisou⟧: flexibility exercises, stretching
- ⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧: stretch (loanword)
